native.hundred_ms_start_offsets: both parity offsets of the per-case native sequence
native.integration: left, right and trapezoid sums over every intervening 20Hz velocity sample
references: ActorSnapshot API reference XY/world velocity, physical COM identity unknown
original rear XY / legacy planar vx,vy rotated using recorded yaw; not full3D rigid-body truth
native.residuals: observed displacement minus velocity integral, in meters and divided by actual dt; errors are descriptive residuals, not admission verdicts
native.offset_identity: delta(rear XY) - delta(API XY) equals delta(rear-minus-API offset); algebraic consistency is not physical-reference validation

future.history: within each fixed64-point window and its recorded origin only
future.short_prefix: explicit unavailable, no pre-anchor lookup or padding

interpretation_limits: No result can retroactively admit any of the eight captures.
Coarse intervals must not erase original100ms curvature failures.
Position and velocity are distinct recorded observables; disagreement alone is not proof of noise, timing delay, physical COM or controller error.
First-index-only repair and dropping warmup/tail are excluded.
A future residual/uncertainty representation requires separate design and independent calibration; no tolerance is fitted to these known failures.
